episode.brief: Build the HelioGrid launch concept review from sources/helio_campaign. Create three genuinely different responsive HTML directions: ROI proof, operator calm, and climate momentum. Keep every claim within the proof packet, compare their audience trade-offs, recommend one, and finish the selected master under results/final_campaign. Save all previews, concept_matrix.csv, review.md, and final.json.
